verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a jitsu-cli that "does everything the UI does" plus a public Management API (docs-47, docs-61). The CLI init/deploy workflow runs from your own repo (gh-6), and the docs explicitly cover CI and headless environments using a personal API key instead of the browser flow (docs-20), backed by named, expiring API tokens (docs-17). missing for 10: concrete CI pipeline examples or recipes (e.g. GitHub Actions), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use, and a machine-discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404 even though a reference is claimed).
